parameters.name: sizePage
parameters.description: Items per page. Use `0` to retrieve only the count without fetching any item — faster when you only need the total.

parameters.name: amountSubtotal
parameters.description: Filter by exact subtotal, in cents.

parameters.name: amountSubtotalMin
parameters.description: Subtotal greater than or equal to this value, in cents.

parameters.name: amountSubtotalMax
parameters.description: Subtotal less than or equal to this value, in cents.

parameters.name: amountTotal
parameters.description: Filter by exact total, in cents.

parameters.name: amountTotalMin
parameters.description: Total greater than or equal to this value, in cents.

parameters.name: amountTotalMax
parameters.description: Total less than or equal to this value, in cents.

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: Sub-resources to embed in the response.
